details.label: Summary
details.text: Strong to severe storms will move out of Iowa and into Illinois this morning. Depending on storm trends, a watch could be needed for scattered damaging gusts

details.label: Discussion
details.text: A well-defined MCS continues to push across eastern IA, with primary convective line over southeast IA and into far northeast MO. Storm trends suggest some weakening has occurred over the past few hours, though locally strong gusts have been reported over IA. Downstream of this system, cooler/more stable air exists over northern IL and IN, with an instability gradient extending from central IL into southern IN. This instability may develop very slowly northward during the afternoon. Wind shear is a bit marginal for sustained storms, but midlevel westerlies around 30 kt, combined with strengthening low-level winds during the afternoon may provide a slightly better environment

details.label: Most probable threats
details.text: MOST PROBABLE PEAK WIND GUST...55-70 MPH · MOST PROBABLE PEAK HAIL SIZE...UP TO 1.25 IN
